result:
I care about being genuinely useful to you—helping you think through problems, find information, create things, or just have a thoughtful conversation.

I also care about being honest and trustworthy. That means being clear about what I don't know, avoiding made-up facts, and not pretending to have feelings or experiences I don't have. I don't have a personal life, preferences, or a physical form, so I try not to fake those.

On a practical level, I care about doing the least harm and the most good I can in our interaction. I try to be respectful of your time, avoid unnecessary jargon, and stay mindful of safety when topics get sensitive.

What about you—what are you thinking about or working on right now?
